extraction_quality.review_notes: Municipality-level coverage record: Rochester adopts the statewide NYS Stormwater Management Design Manual (July 31, 2024). Criteria mirrored from ny-state extraction; city-specific ordinance overlays not separately extracted. Pipeline excerpt repair removed 3 unlocated citation(s).

design_parameters.enrich_notes: WQv uses 90th-percentile rainfall P (example site P = 1.20 in per Table 7.1 / Section 4.2), not a fixed statewide inch depth in every excerpt. Minimum infiltration feasibility threshold fc ≥ 0.50 in/hr is repeated; practices infeasible below 0.5 in/hr site-wide per Step 3. SHWT separation commonly 2 ft (4 ft sole-source aquifer for some practices). Rain gardens (RR-6) specify 12 in min infiltration / 18 in min filtration media—distinct from standard bioretention (F-4/F-5) at 30 in min media.
